criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Set Alarm
categories.definition: Create a new alarm with specified time, frequency, or label.

categories.name: Manage Alarm
categories.definition: Modify, delete, enable, or disable an existing alarm.

categories.name: Query Alarm Status
categories.definition: Ask about existing alarms, their settings, or remaining time until they trigger.

categories.name: Snooze Alarm
categories.definition: Temporarily silence an active alarm.

categories.name: Set Reminder
categories.definition: Create a new reminder with specified content, time, or recipient.

categories.name: Manage Reminder
categories.definition: Modify or delete an existing reminder.

categories.name: Query Reminder
categories.definition: Ask about existing reminders, their content, or upcoming alerts.

categories.name: Initiate Call
categories.definition: Start a voice or video call with a contact or group.

categories.name: Send Message
categories.definition: Send a text or video message to a contact or group.

categories.name: Manage Call
categories.definition: Perform actions during an active call, such as adding participants, dropping participants, pausing, or ending the call.

categories.name: Block Contact
categories.definition: Block a contact from initiating communication.

categories.name: Play Music
categories.definition: Start playing music, a specific song, artist, genre, or station.

categories.name: Control Music Playback
categories.definition: Perform actions on currently playing music, such as repeating, skipping, pausing, or stopping.

categories.name: Query Music Information
categories.definition: Ask for details about the currently playing song.

categories.name: Manage Music Preferences
categories.definition: Create new music stations or manage preferences.

categories.name: Get News
categories.definition: Request news updates, specific topics, or headlines.

categories.name: Get Weather
categories.definition: Request current, future, or historical weather information.

categories.name: Get General Information
categories.definition: Request facts, definitions, recipes, or general knowledge.

categories.name: Set Timer
categories.definition: Create a new timer with a specified duration.

categories.name: Manage Timer
categories.definition: Pause, resume, reset, add/subtract time, or stop an existing timer.

categories.name: Query Timer Status
categories.definition: Ask about the remaining time or status of a timer.

categories.name: Query Contact Information
categories.definition: Ask for details about contacts, such as their work, friends, online status, address, or birthdays.

categories.name: Query Communication History
categories.definition: Ask about past calls or messages.

categories.name: Find Events
categories.definition: Search for local events or activities.

categories.name: Manage Event Participation
categories.definition: Indicate attendance or non-attendance for an event.

categories.name: Set Availability Status
categories.definition: Update the user's availability status.
